notes.content:
Patch notes:

- Added sound when the player speed climbs

notes.title: Pizza Syntwhave: Update notes (May 16, 2023)
The $250$ No-Death-Run Challenge (CLOSED)
notes.content:
Attention all  GAMERS! We would like to announce The Pizza Synthwave $250$ No-Death-Run Challenge.
The first person to complete a full run of the game without dying will get the prize money.
If you would like to participate please sign up here: https://forms.gle/LNuen6uh7WRPud7Q6

Rules: 
 1. To win the No Death Run Challenge Prize you have to complete all 30 levels of Pizza Synthwave without dying on single try.
2. Please upload the video to YouTube or Twitch and send us the link to theseusgamesstudios@gmail.com
3. The video must feature a recording of your complete gameplay and footage of you playing the game with your hands on your keyboard
4. The first person to complete the game without dying will get the prize
5. Do not cheat

notes.title: Day 2 Update
